title: User-facing Console launch sprint kit, operator handbook, and release notes flow
creator: Aisha Rao
description: Goal: Produce a compact, repeatable launch "sprint kit" for the upcoming Console UX feature set (new dashboards, rollout controls, and per-route cost breakdowns) focused on operator readiness and end-customer messaging. The kit will include an operator handbook for on-call and support teams, a coordinated release-notes flow with engineering and design inputs, targeted training modules for support and sales, and an outreach schedule for docs/localization and marketing. We will treat this as a template for future Console launches to reduce coordination overhead and surface regressions early.
acceptance_criteria: Operator handbook drafted and reviewed by SRE and Support (includes rollback checklist, telemetry links, and escalation matrix)
Final release notes committed with changelog, user-impact callouts, and migration notes in confluence/drive
Training: two short video modules (10-12 min) + one facilitator deck for internal trainings complete
Localization plan created for EN, FR, DE with estimated translation effort and due dates
Console UI microcopy reviewed by Design and Legal where required
Post-launch dashboard created: basic health, adoption metrics, cost delta, and top 10 customer queries
tasks: Sync kickoff with Eng (runtime + console), Design, Support, Docs, Marketing — schedule 60m alignment
Draft operator handbook (owner: Miguel) — include playbooks for degraded latency and kv-cache miss storms
Coordinate with ENG to produce telemetry links and dashboard slugs for the post-launch dashboard
Prepare release-notes template and assign owners for each section (what changed, why, impact, rollback steps)
Record two short product videos: feature walkthrough + troubleshooting guide (owner: Sophie Chen)
Create internal facilitator slide deck and quick Q&A cheat sheet for support
Raise localization request with ops and provide copy freeze date
Set cutover and communication windows with Sales and Customer Success; provide demo script
Draft sample customer-facing email and support KB entries
Post-launch: run a 48-hour incident war room drill summary and a 2-week adoption review
